entries.en: The engine the deck is named after gets its own card
entries.body_en: The live page never holds still, so a seed alone cannot bring a picture back. The deck freezes the clock, and these seven numbers are the frozen moment.
entries._audit_body_en: Curated address gesica|seed=1011|cell=3|t=0.0|rot=0.00|zoom=0.00|cx=0.00|cy=0.00 — the deck panel's defaults (src/site/deck/index.html DECK.register id 'gesica'), t=0 per docs/GESICA_DECK.md §2 'a card is the field at time zero'. Live engine persona500.com/gesica redirects to /shards-scroll and reads no address from its URL; the deck panel (#panel-gesica) is the regenerator and is a line-for-line port (same shader, seed math, RNG). KELIBRO-009's back face already carries a GESICA export at seed 1223 cell 6; this card is seed 1011 cell 3, the deck note's worked example. Faces rendered by a later step.
